title: Vanguard staging strategy for embedding model migration and telemetry
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and execute a low-risk "vanguard" staging path for introducing new embedding model variants (including quantized/hardware-specific builds) into the embeddings + reranking endpoint. Goal: preserve or improve quality metrics while keeping tail latency and unit cost predictable for production tenants. This ticket captures the rollout sequencing, telemetry gates, rollback rules, and operational playbook for migrations and deprecations.
acceptance_criteria: A documented staging sequence that moves a new embedding model from shadow -> vanguard -> canary -> gradual ramp with clear duration windows and traffic targets.
Automated telemetry checks that validate quality (recall/rr@k/hit-rate vs baseline), latency (p50/p95), and cost per 1M tokens; thresholds configurable via flags.
Safe fallback implemented: endpoint routes to previous model alias automatically if any gate trips during rollout.
Double-write / shadow-run harness runs for at least 72 hours on representative traffic with detailed diffs surfaced to the console.
Migration runbook that includes reindex guidance for downstream vector stores and tenant communication templates.
implementation_notes: Staging phases: shadow (no-serve) -> vanguard (1–2 tenants, 0.1–1% traffic) -> canary (5–10% traffic, multi-tenant) -> ramp (25/50/100% steps). Each phase has a min-duration and telemetry gate.
Shadow mode: compute embeddings from new model in parallel, persist results to a separate prefix and run offline reranking comparisons. DO NOT route traffic to new vectors until canary passes.
Double-write option: when tenant opts-in, write vectors to both old and new indexes. Provide a 'compare' API that returns similarity delta and scoring differences for sampled queries.
Quality gates: relative rerank hit-rate drop >3% or regression in MRR by >2% vs baseline triggers auto-hold and alert.
Performance gates: p95 latency increase >20% over baseline OR throughput < 80% expected capacity triggers rollback.
Cost gates: unit-cost per 1M tokens increases >15% triggers review (does not auto-rollback but flags finance/infra).

Compatibility checks: embedding dimensionality mismatch or schema changes must be surfaced and rejected automatically; provide model contract validator (dims, dtype, normalization, deterministic flag).
Hardware variants: map model alias to implementation variants (fp16/gpu, int8-quantized, cpu) and maintain a compatibility matrix in the model catalog.
Alias strategy: support 'stable' alias that points to active production model and 'stable-vN' pinned versions for tenants that require immutability.
Index migration: provide a 'snapshot + reindex' flow with estimated time/cost based on index size; recommend staged reindexing for large corpora with versioned index prefixes.
API changes: add 'embedding_version' header in responses and a query param to force previous-variant for debugging (admin-only).
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: silent quality regressions undetected by aggregate metrics. Mitigation: require representative prompt-set evaluation (PR evaluations) and per-tenant small-sample A/B tests during canary.
Risk: increased latency due to new kernel selection for certain sequence lengths. Mitigation: run perf microbenchmarks in CI per hardware type and include a p95 regression test in PR gating.
Risk: index format incompatibilities. Mitigation: enforce model contract checks and add automatic preflight reindex estimators; support fallbacks to old index for reads until reindex completes.
Risk: customer surprise from deprecation. Mitigation: publish deprecation timeline with automation to pin tenants to older alias if required and provide migration support.
